title: Se lo ofrezco a mi compadre: el asesor que se lleva tus leads (Serie Sala de Juntas, video 3)

ia.dice: Los asesores inmobiliarios no perdemos leads: si aquí no hay desarrollo, se lo ofrezco a mi compadre.
ia.prompt: Vertical 9:16 video. Stylized 3D animated cartoon with exaggerated caricature proportions, like a modern animated comedy film. Daytime, inside a parked car right outside a real estate agency office. Rodrigo, a tall thin Mexican real estate agent in his thirties with slicked-back shiny hair, a thin pencil mustache, a shiny grey suit with an open collar and a gold chain, sly smile, sits in the driver seat reading a WhatsApp message on his phone, raises an eyebrow, smirks and turns to the camera saying in Mexican Spanish, fast and confident, like a mockumentary confession: "Los asesores inmobiliarios no perdemos leads: si aquí no hay desarrollo, se lo ofrezco a mi compadre." Medium close-up, static camera. Audio: only his voice in Spanish, quiet street ambience. No music. No subtitles, no on-screen text.

ia.dice: ¡Claro, señora! Le tengo justo lo que busca… / Total, la inmobiliaria ni cuenta se da.
ia.prompt: Vertical 9:16 video. Stylized 3D animated cartoon with exaggerated caricature proportions, like a modern animated comedy film. Same parked car outside the real estate agency. Rodrigo, a tall thin Mexican real estate agent in his thirties with slicked-back shiny hair, a thin pencil mustache, a shiny grey suit with an open collar and a gold chain, sly smile, holds the phone to his ear and says in a sweet, overly friendly voice in Mexican Spanish: "¡Claro, señora! Le tengo justo lo que busca…" Then he lowers the phone, covers it with his hand, winks at the camera and whispers: "Total, la inmobiliaria ni cuenta se da." Medium close-up, static camera. Audio: only his voice in Spanish. No music. No subtitles, no on-screen text.

scenes.text: Ojo: los leads son de tu inmobiliaria, no de tu asesor. Pero si todo pasa en su WhatsApp personal, te los pueden estar robando y ni te enteras.
Lead Master se conecta al WhatsApp y a las llamadas de tus asesores y vendedores, y en automático te dice qué pasó con cada lead. Todos los días te llega el reporte, sin que nadie llene nada.

scenes.text: Las llamadas salen del sistema y quedan grabadas. Y si el asesor se va, los leads y todo su historial se quedan en tu inmobiliaria.
Si tienes una inmobiliaria con asesores, comenta LEADS y te lo instalamos.
